sources.title: FinerWeb-10BT: Refining Web Data with LLM-Based Line-Level Filtering
sources.snippet: Abstract Data quality is crucial for training Large Language Models (LLMs). Traditional heuristic filters often miss low-quality text or mistakenly remove valuable content. In this paper, we introduce an LLM-based line-level filtering method to enhance training data quality.
